snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system run nationally by Health New Zealand (Te Whatu Ora) since 2022. The government has replaced its governance and wants decisions moved closer to communities, with record funding and a focus on patients and waiting times.

priorities.title: Decisions closer to home
priorities.text: Health decisions are to move from the national centre to regions and communities.

priorities.title: New Health NZ governance
priorities.text: New governance and board appointments for Health New Zealand.
